source.body:
### Bug Description

`POST /api/v1/n8n-packages/export` returns HTTP 500 `{"message":"Internal server error"}` whenever one specific archived workflow is included, either alone (`workflowIds: ["<id>"]`) or in a batch. Every other workflow in the same project (73) exports fine. The workflow is archived and does not show up in the UI even with "Show archived workflows", but it is still returned by `GET /api/v1/workflows`.

### To Reproduce

1. POST /api/v1/n8n-packages/export
   {"workflowIds":["<id of the affected workflow>"],"includeArchivedWorkflows":true,"credentialExportPolicy":"no-values","includeVariableValues":false,"missingWorkflowDependencyPolicy":"reference-only"}
2. Response: 500 Internal server error (consistent, retried several times)

### Expected behavior

Either export the workflow or return a 4xx explaining why it cannot be exported, so that a single broken workflow does not make the whole batch fail.
